QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_7

question.text: Which of the following is an advantage of investing in mutual funds compared to direct equity investing?

answer.text: Affordable portfolio diversification even with small investment amounts
Guaranteed protection against all market losses
Complete elimination of systematic risk through diversification

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that mutual funds provide affordable portfolio diversification even for small investment amounts. Other workbook-listed advantages include professional management, economies of scale, liquidity, tax efficiency, transparency, flexibility and regulation. The Trap: Option B is wrong because no investment guarantees protection against all market losses. Option C is wrong because diversification can reduce unsystematic risk but cannot eliminate systematic (market) risk. Option D is wrong because mutual funds charge expense ratios; they are not zero-cost products. Note: Source pages 39, 41, 44 and 237 of NISM Series V-A support the diversification, cost and risk points underlying the keyed answer and the distractors.
